summary: The agent successfully builds a cross-validated ensemble using an appropriate set of classification algorithms. However, the solution suffers from data leakage because both label encoding and median imputation are performed prior to the cross-validation splits (and encoding incorporates the test data). Furthermore, the agent misses opportunities for optimization by failing to perform any feature engineering or tune the weights in the model ensemble.
